problem_statement: The mDNS module needs an alternate platform mechanism to report host address changes: a single notification that all previously-added host IPv4/IPv6 addresses were removed at once, immediately followed by re-adding the current full address list (add-only events). This is for platforms whose network stack can only provide the new full address list rather than identifying individual added or removed addresses. The new platform callback, when invoked for an enabled interface, must discard any pending per-address change events, stop the pending address-change processing, and treat every previously-added host address on that interface as removed, so subsequent re-add events and the resulting mDNS announcements reflect the new complete list. No such 'remove all host addresses' platform callback currently exists, so a platform cannot signal a full host-address removal.
